name: Temporal Axis Resolution Adjustment
definition: Reducing the temporal axis resolution of K-Planes feature grids by narrowing the time normalization range to [-0.8, 0.8] to accommodate camera-specific offsets without harming performance.
summary: Temporal Axis Resolution Adjustment narrows the K-Planes temporal range to [-0.8, 0.8] to handle unsynchronized video offsets without degrading performance.
